dimensions.name: past work
dimensions.evidence: Owned agent design, tools, backend, and Android SSE stream for trip planner; fixed SKU price race with request IDs, cancellation, and regression test; handled delivery risk at Debon Securities by escalating with options and accepting only a delay to his own change.

dimensions.name: current ability
dimensions.evidence: Designed wallet client/server/local DB split, idempotent transfer intent with client ID, cold-start status lookup, four result states, account-tagged results to prevent cross-account leaks, and native confirmation for chat-initiated payments.

dimensions.name: handling unknowns
dimensions.evidence: Clarified users, balance ownership, and offline behavior before designing; handled lost response, process death, duplicate taps, concurrent transfers, account switching, chat stream disconnect, and chat text claiming no confirmation; kept unknown state rather than false failure.

dimensions.name: shipping product
dimensions.evidence: Scoped two-week MVP to confirm screen, intent persistence, status lookup, and four states; identified tech lead and product sign-offs; proposed rollout monitoring, escalation criteria, and needed backend and QA partners.

strongest: Handling unknowns: consistently distinguished unknown from failed, designed idempotent retries, cold-start recovery, and prevented duplicate or cross-account transfers under realistic failure conditions.
risks: Some answers repeated points and the design exercise lacked explicit production evidence or counter-examples beyond the described scenarios; rollout ownership and escalation were reasonable but not deeply tested.
